description: ApolloScape is a research dataset and toolkit for autonomous driving. The official project page describes trajectory prediction and other dataset collections, including 3D LiDAR detection and tracking, scene parsing, lane segmentation, self-localisation, car-instance, stereo and inpainting data. Its overview reports about 1,000 km of urban-traffic trajectories. The official repository lists the trajectory training ZIP recorded here, but this checking environment received HTTP 403 from that address on 2026-10-03, so direct file access is unconfirmed. The old trajectory page returned HTTP 404. The dataset may support traffic and transport simulation. The licence remains unconfirmed because the project's linked licence page also returned HTTP 404.
